target_row: i5 — residual cosmic phase de-sharpening in Type Ia supernovae

EXCLUSIONS.reason: Excluded on i5's explicit instruction so the test stays independent of distance-modulus cosmology, H0 and a0. Absent from every file on main AND from both release tarballs.
EXCLUSIONS.caveat: 0_DATA in the Dovekie version carries LENSDMU / LENSDMU_ERR (lensing magnification distance-modulus correction) in the per-SN HEAD table. It is NOT part of the two excluded directories, but it is a distance-modulus-adjacent quantity — flagged so i5 can drop it if the test requires. The Zenodo v1.2 HEAD table does not have these columns.

github.version_meaning: DES-Dovekie reanalysis (Popovic et al. 2026); upstream README states it supersedes the original DES-SN5YR results

data_paper.data_availability: Paper points at github.com/des-science/DES-SN5YR and doi:10.5281/zenodo.12720777 — exactly the two sources mirrored here.

verified_counts.redshift_range: 0.1 < z < 1.13 (cosmology sample; per Sanchez et al. 2024)
verified_counts.how_checked: NEVT_ALL/NEVT_HOSTGAL_SPECZ from DES-SN5YR_DES.README; row counts read directly from the FITS tables with astropy; mock count = directory count under 1_SIMULATIONS/SNIa_SIMULATIONS.

diffimg_light_curves_31636.detail: Sanchez et al. 2024 describes 31,636 DIFFIMG light curves alongside the 19,706 SMP ones. Only the SMP set is released. A DES-SN5YR_DES_DIFFIMG directory is named in the ReadTheDocs contents list but exists in NO public version — checked HEAD, tag 1.3, tag v1.2 and the Zenodo zip. 0_DATA/README.md still reads 'will be released after acceptance of Sanchez et al. 2024'. Upstream gap, not a fetch failure.

dovekie_simulation_light_curves.detail: The 250 *.FITS.gz under 1_SIMULATIONS at Dovekie HEAD are git-LFS tracked and GitHub returns 'Git LFS is disabled for this repository'. raw.githubusercontent serves a 131-byte pointer stub, HTTP 200. Those stubs were REMOVED from what is published here rather than passed off as data. Mitigation: the 25 Vincenzi-era mocks in the Zenodo v1.2 tarball are complete real files and are included.

version_differences.detail: Checked by git blob SHA: DES/LOWZ/Foundation PHOT files and DES5YR_SALT3_LCFIT.LCPLOT.gz are bit-identical between HEAD and tag 1.3. Only DES-SN5YR_DES_HEAD.FITS.gz (per-SN metadata) differs — regenerated 2025-12-02 per the upstream UPDATES block: 2025-04 filter rename g,r,i,z -> DES-g,DES-r,DES-i,DES-z; 2025-12 corrected HOSTGAL_MAG_[band]/HOSTGAL_MAGERR_[band].
version_differences.tag_1.3_vs_zenodo_v1.2: Over the six kept directories: 725 files identical, 3 differ — all pippin configs (D5yr_analysis.yml, D5yr_biascor.yml, D5yr_sim_nominal.yml).

integrity_guards_run: publisher md5 verified before deriving anything
zip magic bytes checked (PK, not an HTML shell)
every published file scanned for git-LFS pointer stubs
every published file scanned for HTML-shell headers
4_/5_ absence asserted in the staged tree and in both tarball listings
derived_csv_note: derived_csv/ is a pure format conversion (astropy Table.read -> CSV -> gzip). No rows filtered, no columns dropped, no values altered. Provided because FITS is awkward to pull over a URL.
